events.verdict: Sims (MIL) momentarily grasps Schroder's (CLE) arm before immediately releasing him.
Ellis (CLE) grazes Rollins' (MIL) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Rollins (MIL) establishes himself in Schroder's (CLE) path and he absorbs the contact as they come together.
Rollins (MIL) makes contact with the ball as he defends Schroder (CLE) on the perimeter.  Schroder then falls out of bounds on his own and not as a result of any contact from Rollins.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Schroder (CLE) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Schroder maintains possession of the ball as he falls out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Bucks.
Tyson (CLE) makes contact with Porter Jr.'s (MIL) arm that affects his shot attempt.
Green (MIL) moves laterally into Tyson's (CLE) path and delivers contact that affects his SQBR.
Ellis (CLE) dislodges the ball from Rollins (MIL).
Sims (MIL) is moving alongside Schroder's (CLE) path as he defends the drive.
Allen (CLE) directly contests Porter Jr.'s (MIL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Porter Jr.'s hand after the release.
Rollins (MIL) and Schroder (CLE) come together at the same spot and the contact is marginal.
Sims (MIL) drifts slightly forward towards Schroder (CLE) as Schroder's momentum carries him into Sims, and the contact after the release is marginal.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court (successful basket) was overturned to no basket.  Allen (CLE) does not release his shot attempt prior to the expiration of the game clock.
